description: ItemStore.remove() splices index -1 when the id is unknown
recorded: hand-authored replay in the api_response shape; regenerate from a real run with scripts/fixture-from-run.ts

content.text: A DELETE of an unknown id removes another item; that smells like an unchecked findIndex. Reading the store.
remove() calls splice(index, 1) even when findIndex returned -1, which deletes the last element. Failing test first.
Reproduced: 204 and the last item disappears. Guard the index.

input.summary: `ItemStore.remove()` spliced at whatever `findIndex` returned, so an unknown id gave `splice(-1, 1)` and silently deleted the last item while reporting success. It now returns `false` without touching the array when the id is not found, which makes the route answer 404. Added tests/issue-5-delete-unknown.test.ts for the store and the DELETE endpoint.
input.root_cause: Unchecked findIndex() result: splice(-1, 1) removes the last element instead of nothing.
